subject.title: fix(release): publish ClawHub bootstrap artifacts immutably

question: Should the conflict-resolved trusted-main immutable-artifact flow replace the current first-package ClawHub bootstrap for this beta release?
rationale: The final merge chooses the code and bytes admitted to a protected publication token while also changing release-operator workflow; green CI cannot authorize that trust-policy decision.

options.title: Integrate and approve the hardened boundary
options.body: Preserve both current-main release gates and every exact-byte/trusted-code invariant, then approve the exact conflict-resolved head.

options.title: Defer first-package publication
options.body: Leave the new package unpublished until release and security owners can approve a clean integrated boundary.

recommendation.title: Integrate and approve the hardened boundary
recommendation.body: Preserve both current-main release gates and every exact-byte/trusted-code invariant, then approve the exact conflict-resolved head.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the repository's release publication contract and is best placed to coordinate security review and the final operator workflow decision.
